==English== {{rfq|en|pronoun sense: talent or quality}} {{wp|}} ===Alternative forms=== * {{alter|en|somthing||obsolete}} * {{alter|en|sumthing||eye dialect}} * {{alter|en|somethang|sumfin|sumfin'|sumn|sumpin|sumting|sumthang|sumfink||pronunciation spelling}} * {{alter|en|sth|sth.|sthg|smtg|smth|smtn||abbreviations}} ===Etymology=== From {{inh|en|enm|somþyng}}, {{m|enm|some-thing}}, {{m|enm|som thing}}, {{m|enm|sum thinge}}, {{m|enm|sum þinge}}, from {{der|en|ang|sum}} {{m|ang|þing|lit=some thing}}, equivalent to {{compound|en|some|thing}}. Compare {{cog|ang|āwiht|t=something|lit=some thing, any thing}}, {{cog|sv|någonting|t=something|lit=some thing, any thing}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{enPR|sŭmʹthĭng}} * {{a|en|UK}} ** {{IPA|en|/ˈsʌm(p)θɪŋ/|a=RP,Southern England,Scotland}} *** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-something.wav|a=Southern England}} ** {{IPA|en|/ˈsʌm(p)fɪŋ/|a=Southern England,th-fronting}} ** {{a|en|Northern England|Midlands}} *** {{IPA|en|/ˈsʊm(p)θɪŋ/|a=ng-coalescence}} *** {{IPA|en|/ˈsʊm(p)fɪŋ/|a=ng-coalescence,th-fronting}} *** {{IPA|en|/ˈsʊm(p)θɪŋɡ/|a=non-ng-coalescence}} *** {{IPA|en|/ˈsʊm(p)fɪŋɡ/|a=non-ng-coalescence,th-fronting}} ** {{IPA|en|/ˈsəm(p)θɪŋ/|a=Wales}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈsʌm(p)θɪŋ/|/ˈsʌnθɪŋ/|a=US}} (''sometimes reduced to {{IPAchar|[ˈsʌ(m)ʔm̩]}} or {{IPAchar|[ˈsʌɾ̃ɪŋ]}}, or even monosyllabically to {{IPAchar|[sʌ̃ː]}} or {{IPAchar|[sʌˑɪŋ]}}'') ** {{audio|en|en-us-something.ogg|a=California}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈsɐm(p)θɪŋ/|a=AU}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈsɐm(p)θəŋ/|a=NZ}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈsʊm.t̪ɪŋ/|a=IE}} ** {{IPA|en|/ˈsʊm.tɪn/|/ˈsʊm.tɪŋ/|a=Dublin}} * {{hyphenation|en|some|thing}} ===Pronoun=== {{en-pron|desc=[[indefinite pronoun]]}} # An [[uncertain]] or [[unspecified]] [[thing]]; [[one]] thing. #: {{syn|en|sth|q1=especially in dictionaries}} #: {{ux|en|I must have forgotten to pack '''something''', but I can't think what.}} #: {{ux|en|I have '''something''' for you in my bag.}} #: {{ux|en|I have a feeling '''something''' good is going to happen today.}} #: {{ux|en|The answer to four down is P '''something''' T '''something''' Y.}} #: ''She looked thirty-'''something'''.'' (anything from thirty-one to thirty-nine years old) #* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-06-28|author=w:Joris Luyendijk |volume=189|issue=3|page=21|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly |title=[http://www.guardian.co.uk/commentisfree/joris-luyendijk-banking-blog/2013/jun/19/banking-britain-beyond-control Our banks are out of control] |passage=Seeing the British establishment struggle with the financial sector is like watching an alcoholic who still resists the idea that '''something''' drastic needs to happen for him to turn his life around.}} # {{lb|en|colloquial|of someone or something}} A [[quality]] to a [[moderate]] [[degree]]. #: {{ux|en|The performance was '''something''' of a disappointment.}} #: {{ux|en|That child is '''something''' of a genius.}} #: {{ux|en|It was '''something''' of a disappointment.}} #: {{ux|en|The car has '''something''' of a history attached to it.}} #* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=5|passage=Then came a maid with hand-bag and shawls, and after her a tall young lady. She stood for a moment holding her skirt above the grimy steps, with '''something''' of the stately pose which Richter has given his Queen Louise on the stairway, and the light of the reflector fell full upon her.}} # {{lb|en|colloquial|of a person}} A [[talent]] or quality that is [[difficult]] to [[specify]]. #: {{syn|en|je ne sais quoi}} #: {{ux|en|She has a certain '''something'''.}} # {{lb|en|colloquial|often with [[really]] or [[quite]]}} Somebody who or something that is superlative or notable in some way. #: {{ux|en|He's really '''something'''! I've never heard such a great voice.}} #: {{ux|en|She's quite '''something'''. I can't believe she would do such a mean thing.}} #: {{ux|en|Some marmosets are less than six inches tall. —Well, isn't that '''something'''?}} #* {{quote-journal|en|date=2016-08-29|author=Anna Moeslein|title=The Best and Worst Moments of the MTV VMAs 2016|journal=w:[[Glamour (magazine)|Glamour]]|url=https://www.glamour.com/story/mtv-vma-2016-best-and-worst-moments|passage={{w|Kanye West|Kanye {{q-g|West}}}}'s speech was...'''something''', that's for sure. As for a best or worst moment? Apparently, it depends on what you think of Yeezy because Twitter was a house Also used to refer to an object earlier indefinitely referred to as 'something' (pronoun sense). #*: Moreover, in all of our experience with these sense impressions, we never lose sight of the fact that they are but incidental facts of our mental existence, and that there is a '''Something''' Within which is really the Subject of these sense reports—a '''Something''' to which these reports are presented, and which receives them. ====Translations==== {{trans-top}} * Spanish: {{trans-bottom}} {{cln|en|autological terms|compound determinatives|degree adverbs|indefinite pronouns|refractory feminine rhymes|third person pronouns|positive polarity items}}
